resources.string:
Allergies, medications, conditions, blood group, vaccinations, medical notes and medical photos are health details about your child.

• Your co-parent can read and edit them. Any guest you give access to your child's record can read them.
• They are stored on our servers.
• They are optional. The app works without them.
• You can withdraw your consent at any time in Settings. The medical details you added are then deleted.
Medical details are optional and need your consent first.

The medical details you added to your children\'s records — allergies, medications, the medical profile, medical notes and medical photos — will be deleted, on your co-parent\'s phone too.\n\nRecords your co-parent created keep their medical details, because they rest on your co-parent\'s own consent.
Consent withdrawn. The medical details you added were deleted.
Some medical photos could not be deleted, so nothing was withdrawn. Check your connection and try again.
Your consent could not be withdrawn. Try again.
